source.title: The Role of Early Bioelectric Signals in the Regeneration of Planarian Anterior/Posterior Polarity.
source.location: Figure 2B legend (panel f) and Results section 'Early alteration of bioelectric state...' (text: 13% vs 0% control; remaining 87%)

stage: trunk fragment (PT fragment: posterior to pharynx, anterior to tail)

intervention.description: PT fragments placed in nigericin with added potassium gluconate for the first 3 h after amputation, then moved to water

readout.method: scoring of eyes at the anterior and posterior poles of regenerates
readout.timepoint: 14 days regeneration (scored at day 14 or later)

notes: Text: 13% double-headed; 'the remaining 87% ... formed morphologically normal single-headed worms', so normal 87 is the paper's own complement (stated). Converted from percentages (outcome_from_percent true). Legend for panel f gives N=132 for the Fisher's exact comparison, but the arm-level denominator is not stated separately, so n_total null. Control (0%) row not written: no complement stated for control arm. Ionophore dose 0.24 uM with 15 mM potassium gluconate per Methods.

source.title: The Role of Early Bioelectric Signals in the Regeneration of Planarian Anterior/Posterior Polarity.
source.location: Figure 2C legend (panel f) and Results section (monensin paragraph: 12% double-headed vs 0% controls)

stage: trunk fragment (PT fragment: posterior to pharynx, anterior to tail)

intervention.description: PT fragments placed in monensin with added sodium gluconate for the first 3 h after amputation, then moved to water

readout.method: scoring of eyes at the anterior and posterior poles of regenerates
readout.timepoint: 14 days regeneration (scored at day 14 or later)

notes: Text: 12% double-headed of treated worms; legend gives N=89 for the Fisher's exact comparison. 12% of 89 is not an integer (10.7), so stored as a percentage with outcome_from_percent true and n_total null; n=89 recorded here. Remainder (non-double-headed) outcome not characterised for this arm in the text, so only the stated category is entered. Sodium gluconate 90 mM per Methods.
